recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR source follow-up is needed unless a future Kindling update regresses the scanForPages or scanForImages filename-extension guard.
issue_request: FHIR-13597 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core tooling issue asking that Publisher.java not abort when scanForPages or scanForImages encounters an extraneous build-output file without a filename suffix.
initial_application: Git commit 48c2dd532de7226381382e377156fae0b2bda987, matching Jira comment svn revision 12624, changed both scanForPages and scanForImages in tools/java/org.hl7.fhir.tools.core/src/org/hl7/fhir/tools/publisher/Publisher.java to use f.getName().contains(".") before taking the substring.
additional_context: The affected Publisher.java source is no longer present in the current FHIR checkout. Commit 9f549566d1346cad7db6d2afca6080d7cebdfbbe removed tools/java/org.hl7.fhir.tools.core and switched the build to org.hl7.fhir:kindling. Current build.gradle.kts runs org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from that dependency, and current HL7/kindling Publisher.java still has the same dot-presence guard in scanForPages and scanForImages. Zulip and Confluence searches found no substantive conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR source file was edited because the Jira-requested guard was historically applied, the obsolete in-repo source was externalized, and the current external publisher source used by the FHIR build preserves the corrected behavior.
